messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

A reminder that next Thursday's lunch & learn covers recent developments in EMI option schemes and Schedule 5 ITEPA qualifying conditions, 12:30 in the Bishopsgate room. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to me.

Donna
